plain_english_policy: The option supports providing free or low-cost television advertising to candidates who agree to voluntary campaign spending limits.
evidence_quote: Provide free or low-cost television advertising to candidates who agree to voluntary campaign spending limits.
review_reason: This option combines two distinct concepts: public subsidies for media access (often associated with progressive views on equality of opportunity) and voluntary spending caps (a hallmark of conservative small-d government ideology). The net ideological direction is mixed or context-dependent.
